registered_bases.FULL: args {config: 'hall_icp_neutralizer', variant: [], label: <case id>, power_basis: null, gate_measurement: null}; loads[s] = {P_W: 10.0, evidence_class: 'measured', source: 'src:' + s} for every s in installed_slots(config, variant) (icp_rf_source additionally plane 'generator_dc_input'); efficiencies[s] = {value: 0.9, evidence_class: 'measured', source: 'eff:' + s, path: 'internal_bus'}; front_end = {value: 0.95, evidence_class: 'measured', source: 'fe'}. A case's 'set' assigns dotted paths after the base is built (variant first, so the installed set follows it), 'del' deletes dotted paths. Pseudo-keys: '$all_paths' sets every efficiency path; '$all_loads_tbd' / '$all_effs_tbd' make every installed load / efficiency TBD (tbd_requires 'tbd:' + slot; rf keeps its plane; efficiency keeps path internal_bus); '$all_loads_value' sets every installed P_W
registered_bases.TPL: check_startup_sequence args {config: 'hall_icp_neutralizer', variant: [], front_end: FULL front_end, steps: one step per SEQUENCE_TEMPLATES['hall_icp_neutralizer'] entry (I-S0..I-S6) with step_id, event and phase of the template; loads: every installed slot of every step, 10.0 W (FULL record) if the slot is in the union of the 'on' lists of this and the earlier steps, else 0.0 W (FULL record shape); efficiencies: the FULL efficiencies; power_basis 'p_bus_1ms_max' and gate_measurement GM_OK on every step}. Pseudo-keys: '$swap_events' [i, j] swaps the event of steps i and j; '$keep_steps' [k...] keeps only the listed steps (the steady step's phase is kept); '$cooling_step' (with variant ['active_cooling']: active_cooling is installed, 0.0 W in every template step, FULL efficiency) inserts after I-S1 a step 'I-S1c' (event active_cooling_start, loads of I-S1) and sets active_cooling to 10.0 W in it and in every later step; '$all_bases' sets power_basis on every step; '$all_loads_tbd_after' k makes every installed load TBD in every step after step k

draw.rng: Python random.Random(master_seed * 1000 + k) with k = 2 (E2), 7 (E7), 3 (E3), 4 (E4), 9 (E9); draws in the order written here
draw.E2: variant = choice of [[], ['icp_assist_magnet'], ['active_cooling'], ['flow_control_icp_feed'], ['icp_assist_magnet', 'active_cooling', 'flow_control_icp_feed'], ['flow_control_icp_feed', 'icp_assist_magnet']]; p_tbd = choice([0.0, 0.0, 0.1, 0.3]); p_off = choice([0.0, 0.15]); p_eff_tbd = choice([0.0, 0.0, 0.1]); for every installed slot in ALL_SLOTS order: u = random(); u < p_tbd -> TBD load (tbd_requires 'tbd:' + slot); u < p_tbd + p_off -> 0.0 W; else P_W = round(uniform(0, 900), choice([0, 3, 6, 17])) with evidence_class = choice(EVIDENCE_CLASSES), source 'src:' + slot (rf plane added); efficiency: random() < p_eff_tbd -> TBD with path choice(PATHS), else value = 1.0 if random() < 0.1 else uniform(0.5, 1.0), evidence_class choice, path choice(PATHS); every declared variant option not installed is passed as the exactly-0 W / efficiency-1 record with probability 0.3; front_end TBD with probability 0.15 else uniform(0.85, 1.0) with evidence_class choice; power_basis = choice([None] + POWER_BASES); gate_measurement = choice([None, GM_OK, GM_OK with sample_rate 50000.0, GM_OK with anti_alias_documented False]); label 'R2-<n>'
draw.E7: variant = choice([[], ['active_cooling']]); n = randint(2, 7) steps; efficiencies and front_end drawn once as in E2; loads start at 0.0 W for every installed slot; per step: each installed slot changes with probability 0.3 to uniform(0, 600) (rounded to 3 decimals), to 0.0, or to TBD (equal thirds); event = choice([None, None, one flight event whose slot is installed, a list of two such events]); power_basis choice as E2; step_id 'S<i>'; the last step carries phase 'steady'
draw.E3: fs = choice([100000.0, 200000.0, 1000000.0, 100000]); bw = choice([20000.0, 50000.0]); n1 = round(fs * 1e-3); length = n1 + randint(0, 3 n1) (one draw in ten: 10000 + randint(0, 500) at 100000.0 Sa/s); samples uniform(0, 1500) rounded to 2 decimals with a spike of uniform(1500, 4000) at a random index
draw.E4: dc = uniform(0, 600); fw = uniform(0, dc); rf = uniform(0, fw); delivered = 'TBD' with probability 0.2 else uniform(0, fw - rf); u = choice([0.0, 0.5, 2.0]); with probability 0.2 one of: rf = fw + u + uniform(0.1, 5), fw = dc + u + uniform(0.1, 5), delivered = fw - rf + u + uniform(0.1, 5)
draw.E9: steady = one E2 draw (same rules, its own stream), startup = randint(1, 3) E2 draws; synthetic = choice([absent, True, False]); source = choice([absent, 'random source <n>']); compressor_P_W = choice([None, uniform(0, 200)])

definition.inputs: one COMPLETE bus_power_boundary_a9_v2 ledger L of one evaluated step and a set of downstream accounts a = {account_id, slot_planes [(slot, plane)], deposited_W, exported_W, booked_W, status, source}; plane LOAD = P_W (the slot's load plane), SUPPLY_INPUT = P_W / eta_slot, BUS = P_bus_W (spacecraft side); the plane is declared by the account, never defaulted
definition.coverage: every installed item of L with P_W > 0 appears in exactly one account; a slot in two accounts -> MODEL_ERROR (CONS-L1_DOUBLE_COUNT); an ON slot in no account -> NOT_EVALUATED (CONS-L1_UNCOVERED_LOAD, never zero-filled); a slot not installed in L -> MODEL_ERROR (CONS-L1_SLOT_NOT_INSTALLED); a negative or non-finite account amount -> MODEL_ERROR
definition.status: L not COMPLETE -> INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE (P_bus unknown; no residual); any account status other than EVALUATED -> that status (worst of MODEL_ERROR > OUT_OF_DOMAIN > NOT_EVALUATED > INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE)
definition.computation: V_a = fsum over the account's slots of the ledger value at the declared plane; X_a = fsum over its slots of (P_bus_W - plane value) (supply / front-end loss booked outside the account, at the PPU); C_a = deposited_W + exported_W + booked_W; S = fsum over accounts of (C_a + X_a); R = P_bus_W(L) - S; r = |R| / P_bus_W(L) (P_bus_W(L) = 0: r = 0 if R = 0 else infinity)
definition.criterion: r < 0.02 -> EVALUATED with R, r and the per-account mismatch V_a - C_a reported; r >= 0.02 -> MODEL_ERROR (CONS-L1_RESIDUAL: conservation is a gate, rule 4), the same numbers reported
definition.thermal_accounts: from a CONVERGED steady NP-THERMAL ThermalOutput: HALL_DISCHARGE = hall_discharge @ LOAD, deposited = sum over nodes of Q_source_node_W for Q_hall_anode_W, Q_hall_wall_inner_W, Q_hall_wall_outer_W, Q_hall_pole_W, Q_hall_plasma_radiation_W, Q_hall_return_to_icp_W, Q_hall_plume_to_icp_W, exported = P_exported_W['P_hall_exported_W'] (it already holds the jet, the unattributed remainder and the EXPORT share of Q_hall_plasma_radiation_W; 'Q_hall_plasma_radiation_W.EXPORT' and 'P_hall_unattributed_W' are subsets and are not added); HALL_MAGNET_X = hall_magnet_X @ LOAD, deposited = Q_source_node_W 'Q_hall_coil_X_W'; ICP = the ICP slots at the planes the case declares, deposited = Q_source_node_W of Q_icp_plasma_wall_W, Q_icp_coil_ohmic_W, Q_icp_match_W, Q_icp_radiation_W, exported = P_exported_W['Q_icp_extraction_W'] + P_exported_W['Q_icp_radiation_W.EXPORT'] (when present), booked = B_PPU_RF_booked['Q_icp_boundary_W'] + B_PPU_RF_booked['Q_icp_match_W'] (when present) (their sum is P_icp_bus_W by E-13 / CONS-I2); THERMAL_CONTROL = thermal_control @ LOAD, deposited = Q_source_node_W 'Q_thermal_control_W'. Slots outside the thermal control volume (compressor, flow controls, housekeeping, reserved port, active cooling) need caller-declared external accounts (no default)
